question: Can observed PMXT trade prints justify a conservative one-tick passive-entry fill model that improves the known strict-42 loss cluster?

pre_registered_contract.limit_rule: decision-time best ask minus one 0.01 tick
pre_registered_contract.size_rule: reuse the exact taker trade share count; do not increase size at the cheaper maker price
pre_registered_contract.arrival_rule: reject if the fixed limit crosses the arrival ask or sits below the arrival best bid
pre_registered_contract.queue_ahead_rule: freeze visible bid size at the limit on arrival
pre_registered_contract.queue_depletion_rule: count unique explicit SELL trade prints at the limit; give no credit for cancellations or later book-size reductions
pre_registered_contract.price_through_rule: an explicit SELL print below the resting buy limit implies full fill
pre_registered_contract.scope_rule: test the known failing tail first; expand to 42 folds only if the fixed tail screen is viable

trade_side_validation.interpretation: The retained side field behaves predominantly as aggressor side. The fill screen therefore allows only SELL prints to deplete a resting buy queue.

implementation_audit.current_backtest: Maker::fill_with_key uses a fixed maker_fill_prob, default 0.65, and a deterministic seeded draw.
implementation_audit.current_archive_reader: DistilledEvent::Trade is retained on disk but explicitly skipped by read_distilled.
implementation_audit.current_promotion_gate: prefer_maker variants are rejected because the fill probability is not queue/trade calibrated.
implementation_audit.live_timeout_gap: CANDLE_MAKER_TIMEOUT_S defaults to 3.0 but has no implemented live cancel path.

limitations: Only 26 of 40 tail trades have retained trade tape in the local full distilled cache.
The archive exposes aggregated price levels, not order IDs or exact queue position.
The no-cancellation-credit rule is intentionally conservative and may understate fills.
All six inferred fills are price-through fills; no order cleared the frozen queue from prints at its own limit.
The screen is a standalone causal reconstruction, not an integrated harness variant.
The fixed screen failed before a 42-fold expansion or fresh-window replay was warranted.

verdict.grade: A- research system; strategy remains below A+
verdict.reason: Observed passive fills are too sparse, the covered counterfactual remains negative, and tape coverage is incomplete. Implementing a trade-aware maker path would add lifecycle complexity without promotion-grade evidence.
blocked_followups: Do not tune timeout, price offset, queue discount, or regime filters on this tail cohort.
Do not enable prefer_maker or interpret the synthetic 0.65 maker replay as evidence.
Do not add a maker-to-taker fallback: the prior fixed persistence screen already showed that delayed re-entry disproportionately removes winners.
verdict.next_mechanism_class: new exogenous information with demonstrable incremental predictive value on the opportunity-complete cohort
